siblings.title: Things to do in Wolfsburg
siblings.summary: A two-to-three-day Wolfsburg itinerary built around Autostadt, Phaeno and the Allerpark — with the post-March-2026 reality that Aqua, the city's only Michelin star, has closed.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events in Wolfsburg
siblings.summary: Wolfsburg's tech calendar is VW-gravity: IZB (Oct 2026, ~40k visitors) and Circularity Days (May 2026) dominate; pure-IT generalist conferences don't really exist here. The community pulse is meetups, phaeno science talks, and 42 open days.
